title: Biased query score at a query node
statement: Let $p\in\mathbb{R}$, let $T_v$ be a finite decision tree on sign-valued inputs for each $v\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $i$ be an available coordinate. For every sign-valued input $x$, the biased query score of the tree that queries $i$ and then follows $T_{x_i}$ is the standardized biased value of $x_i$ plus the biased query score of $T_{x_i}$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The queried coordinate belongs to the available coordinates
Each child is a finite decision tree on sign-valued inputs with the queried coordinate removed
$x$ is a sign-valued input on $n$ coordinates
